title: Ready?
lessons: The player spots the 'Ready?' campaign on a terminal digital ad: Harry Kane and Declan Rice fronting Oura instead of a wellness influencer.
The player lands after a difficult trip and turns on Rest Mode instead of chasing a normal activity goal.

text: The screen above the gate cycles two footballers, Harry Kane and Declan Rice, under one word. Ready? Then the boarding lights come on.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Since when do footballers front an ad like this?

entry-first-2.speaker: OURA
text: Since this one. Kane and Rice, not someone filming their morning routine. I wanted a face that gets asked that question for a living.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: That's a different kind of ready than mine right now.

entry-first-4.speaker: OURA
text: I know. You've been awake since four. The ad's for the person who sees it on the way to a match. You're seeing it on the way to a middle seat.

choice-first.speaker: OURA
text: Boarding's in six minutes. You keep looking up at it.

choices.text: I trust an athlete's readiness more than an influencer's morning routine.
Bigger stars, same question of what the ring actually measures.
I don't need Harry Kane to tell me how I slept.

first-1.speaker: OURA
text: Then the face on the screen did something before I was anywhere near your hand. I'll have to live up to that later. Quietly.

first-2.speaker: OURA
text: That's fair. A bigger name on the screen doesn't answer a smaller question in the app. I'd rather you ask the small one.

first-3.speaker: OURA
text: No. He doesn't know how you slept. Neither do I, yet. That part was never his.
You land after a bad trip. The activity ring on your phone is nowhere near closed. There's an option you've never used: Rest Mode.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: My activity goal is not happening today.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: You're telling me to do less?

entry-return-4.speaker: OURA
text: Today. Jet lag is what Rest Mode is for. I pause the activity goal and stop nudging. The guidance turns toward sleep instead of steps.

choice-return.speaker: OURA
text: Your call. I've said my one thing.

choices.text: I like that you can stop pushing when the day changes.
I shouldn't need a setting to give myself permission to rest.
If I'm exhausted, I already know I'm exhausted.

return-1.speaker: OURA
text: Good. I'm most useful when I know when to go quiet. I'm still learning when that is.

return-2.speaker: OURA
text: That's fair. Permission from an app is still permission from an app. I'd rather you didn't need it from me.

return-3.speaker: OURA
text: Then you didn't need me for this one. You knew. Sleep.
